Before you start

Set up the test environment

The preview build only shows the new behaviour when the backend it calls runs PR #810 and the feature flags below are on.

Builds

  • Frontend: the PR #1862 preview, or any build of feature/events-v2-web at 450f75fa.
  • Backend: PR #810 deployed to the backend that build calls, with its migrations run (up to 2026_10_29_000007). Without it, Delete, the Draft refusal and the retry protection are missing.

Accounts

  • Admin A: all permissions (an owner works).
  • Admin B: a role with view PaymentGateway but without manage DonationReceipt and without view FundraisingEvent.
  • A donor account on the website.

Data

  • A published Ticketed event with booking open, one paid and one free ticket type.
  • A Draft Ticketed event with at least one ticket type.
  • Two discount codes: one for all tickets (10%), one aimed at the event.
  • Chrome DevTools for cases that need a slow or cut network (Network panel, Slow 3G or Offline).

Feature flags (set in Netlify, then rebuild)

NEXT_PUBLIC_DISCOUNT_CODES=true NEXT_PUBLIC_OFFLINE_DONATIONS=true NEXT_PUBLIC_MANUAL_TICKETS=true NEXT_PUBLIC_TICKETS_EXPORT=true NEXT_PUBLIC_WAITLIST=true NEXT_PUBLIC_TICKET_ORDER=true NEXT_PUBLIC_PAID_PER_USER_LIMIT=true NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_DISCOUNT_CODES=true NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_ICS=true NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_TICKET_EXTRAS=true NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_NOTIFY_ME=true NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_PAID_LIMIT=true NEXT_PUBLIC_REFUNDS=false (no backend yet)

The old names (NEXT_PUBLIC_EV2_…, NEXT_PUBLIC_EV2W_…) still work, so an environment that has them needs no change. See PL-1.

Dashboard

Discount codes

DC-1

Discount codes action on the events list

Manual

Ticketed events get a Discount codes action in their row, next to the other row actions.

Steps

  1. Log in to the dashboard as Admin A.
  2. Open Fundraising Events.
  3. Hover the percent icon in a Ticketed event's row, then click it.

Expected

  • Only Ticketed events have the percent icon; its label is "Discount codes".
  • Clicking it opens Discount Codes filtered to that event, with the event's codes listed.
DC-2

Delete a discount code

Manual

New Delete action on each code. A deleted code leaves the list and stops working at checkout; purchases already made with it keep their discount.

Steps

  1. On Discount Codes, click Delete on a code.
  2. Confirm with Delete.
  3. On the website, try the deleted code at checkout.
  4. Back in the dashboard, create a new code with the same text.

Expected

  • A confirmation asks "Delete this discount code?".
  • After confirming: "Discount code deleted." and the row disappears.
  • The deleted code is refused at checkout as not valid.
  • The same text can be used for a new code.
DC-3

Discount Codes menu entry follows permissions

Needs setup

The menu entry only shows to admins who can view fundraising events, the permission the Discount Codes list needs. It used to be added for every admin.

Steps

  1. Log in as Admin A and look at the sidebar.
  2. Log in as Admin B and look again.

Expected

  • Admin A sees Discount codes in the sidebar.
  • Admin B does not see it.
Dashboard

Offline donations

OD-1

Record offline donation follows permissions

Needs setup

Recording writes money and receipts, so the button needs manage DonationReceipt, the permission the backend checks.

Steps

  1. As Admin A, open Donations.
  2. As Admin B, open Donations.

Expected

  • Admin A sees Record offline donation.
  • Admin B does not. Before this change the button showed, and recording failed at the end with an authorization error.
OD-2

Donation date in the organisation's timezone

Needs setup

"Today" used to be the UTC date. In Toronto after 8 pm the form defaulted to tomorrow and the backend refused it. It now uses the organisation's timezone.

Steps

  1. Open Profile → Tax Receipting and set Timezone to one far from UTC, for example Pacific/Kiritimati (UTC+14). Save.
  2. Open Record offline donation and look at Date received.
  3. Try to pick the next day in the date picker.
  4. Record a donation dated today.
  5. Put the timezone back.

Expected

  • The date defaults to today in the organisation's timezone, which can differ from today in UTC.
  • No later day can be picked.
  • Recording a donation dated today never fails with a "date in the future" error.

Checked locally: with the organisation in Pacific/Kiritimati the UTC day was 6 Oct and the form defaulted to 7 Oct, with 7 Oct as the latest date.

OD-3

Upload both cheque photos at once

Manual

Two uploads at once used to clear the "Uploading…" state early, and the second photo to finish erased the first.

Steps

  1. Open Record offline donation and choose Cheque.
  2. Pick a front photo and, right away, a back photo. Slow 3G in DevTools makes this easier to watch.
  3. Wait for both to finish.

Expected

  • Each side shows its own "Uploading…".
  • Record donation stays disabled until both sides are done, even when one side finishes first.
  • Both photos stay in place; neither replaces the other.
OD-4

Interrupted cheque upload leaves Record usable

Manual

Switching away from Cheque, or closing the dialog, during an upload used to leave Record donation disabled until the page was reloaded.

Steps

  1. Set DevTools to Slow 3G, choose Cheque and pick a photo.
  2. While it says "Uploading…", switch the method to Cash.
  3. Repeat, but close the dialog during the upload, then open it again.

Expected

  • After switching to Cash, Record donation is usable.
  • After reopening, the form is empty and Record donation is usable.
  • The photo from the interrupted upload never shows up later.
OD-5

Donor search says why it failed

Needs setup

A refused or failed search used to say "No donor found — switch to New donor", which could lead to a duplicate donor.

Steps

  1. Log in as an admin whose role has manage DonationReceipt (not the owner), open Record offline donation and leave it open.
  2. In another browser, as the owner, remove manage DonationReceipt from that admin's role.
  3. Back in the open dialog, type two letters in the donor search.
  4. Separately: with DevTools set to Offline, type in the donor search.

Expected

  • Refused: "You don't have permission to search donors."
  • Network or server failure: "Could not search donors. Please try again."
  • "No donor found" only appears when the search worked and found nobody.
OD-6

A retry records the donation once

Optional

If the answer is lost after the server recorded the donation (a timeout), pressing the button again used to record it twice. The dialog now sends the same request key with every attempt.

Steps

  1. Fill the form and click Record donation.
  2. Right after clicking, set DevTools to Offline.
  3. When the dialog shows "The donation could not be recorded.", go back online and click Record donation again.
  4. Check the Donations list.

Expected

  • Exactly one new donation, and at most one receipt.
  • Closing and reopening the dialog starts a new donation as usual.

Checked locally: the first answer was cut after the server had recorded the donation; the second click showed "Offline donation recorded." and the database had one new donation.

Dashboard

Complimentary tickets

CT-1

No complimentary tickets for a Draft event

Needs setup

Issuing tickets on a Draft event used to work, and sent the draft's numbers out on its public progress feed. It is now refused, like a sale.

Steps

  1. Open Event Ticket Sales for the Draft Ticketed event.
  2. Click Issue tickets, fill the form and submit.
  3. Publish the event and try again.

Expected

  • Draft: "Publish the event before issuing tickets for it." No tickets issued, no email sent.
  • Published: the tickets are issued as before.
CT-2

A retry issues the tickets once

Optional

Same protection as OD-6, for Issue tickets.

Steps

  1. On a published event, fill Issue tickets and submit.
  2. Right after submitting, set DevTools to Offline; go back online when the error shows; submit again.

Expected

  • The tickets are issued once and the email is sent once.
Website

Ticket purchase

Sign in as the donor and open the published Ticketed event. If a donation popup opens on the page, close it with Maybe later.

WS-1

Apply a discount code at checkout

Manual

Baseline for the next cases. The code is checked by the server, which also prices the purchase.

Steps

  1. Click Book Ticket and choose the paid type.
  2. Type the 10% code and click Apply.

Expected

  • The code box shows the old total struck through, the new total and the amount saved. For one CAD 30 ticket: CAD 30.00, CAD 27.00, you save CAD 3.00.
WS-2

Quick quantity changes re-price once

Manual

Each +/− click used to send its own check, using up the buyer's request limit, and an older answer could show the totals of another quantity.

Steps

  1. With the code applied, click + three times quickly.
  2. Optional: watch the Network panel while clicking.

Expected

  • The totals dim and "Checking…" shows.
  • Then the totals match the final quantity: 4 × CAD 30 = CAD 120.00, CAD 108.00 after 10%.
  • One check is sent for the burst of clicks, not one per click.
WS-3

Remove right after a quantity change

Manual

A check that was still waiting could bring a removed code back.

Steps

  1. With the code applied, click + and then Remove immediately.
  2. Wait a few seconds.

Expected

  • The code stays removed and the empty code field is back.
  • It does not reappear a moment later, and a purchase is sent without the code.
WS-4

The code check fails with no network

Manual

A failed re-check used to show nothing, leaving old totals on screen.

Steps

  1. With the code applied, set DevTools to Offline.
  2. Click +.
  3. Go back online and click Apply.

Expected

  • "Could not check the code. Please try again." shows under the field, with the code back in it.
  • Back online, Apply works and the totals match the quantity.
WS-5

Per-person limit already reached

Not testable yet

A buyer who has bought the whole per-person limit of a paid type used to see "Up to 0 ticket(s) of this type per person." with Buy still enabled.

Expected once testable

  • "You've reached the limit of N ticket(s) of this type per person." in red.
  • Buy Now disabled for that type; other types can still be bought.

Why it can't be tested yet

The event page loads the event without the buyer's sign-in, so it never receives how many tickets the buyer has left. Today the page shows "Up to N…" and the server refuses at Buy Now with the limit message. A follow-up is proposed.

WS-6

No discount field on the older checkout

Needs setup

With NEXT_PUBLIC_EVENT_TICKETS=false the site uses the older checkout, which cannot carry a code. The field used to show anyway, with a discounted total the buyer never got.

Steps

  1. On a build with NEXT_PUBLIC_EVENT_TICKETS=false, open Book Ticket and choose a paid type.

Expected

  • No discount code field. With the flag on (the default) the field shows as in WS-1.
WS-7

A declined card is not shown as "seats taken"

Optional

A card declined as expired (Stripe code expired_card) was read as a lost seat race.

Expected

  • A declined card ends in "The payment did not go through. Please try again."
  • "Those seats were taken — you were not charged" appears only when another buyer took the last seats.

How

Needs a decline that reaches the payment result page. Stripe's in-form errors (for example its test card 4000 0000 0000 0069) usually stop earlier, in the card form. Covered by automated tests.

WS-8

Tickets page with a broken link

Manual

The payment reference in ?ref= went into a backend address unchecked. Anything that isn't a real reference is now ignored.

Steps

  1. Signed in as the donor, open /tickets?event_id=1&ref=../../../users/admin%23.
  2. Wait about 30 seconds.

Expected

  • The page loads normally, with no error.
  • After about 30 seconds it shows its usual "could not confirm yet" message, the same as for any unknown payment.
Configuration

Flags and builds

PL-1

New and old feature flag names

Needs setup

The flags lost their "EV2" prefix: NEXT_PUBLIC_EV2_<X> became NEXT_PUBLIC_<X> and NEXT_PUBLIC_EV2W_<X> became NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_<X>. The old names are still read.

Steps

  1. On a build with only the old names, open the dashboard and the site.
  2. Rename the variables in Netlify to the new names, rebuild, and look again.

Expected

  • The same features show in both builds.
  • A flag set to false under its new name wins over the old name.
PL-2

A feature without a backend fails openly

Optional

Turning on a feature whose backend isn't ready used to show fake successes from built-in sample data. Production builds now refuse that sample data. Refunds is the only such feature left.

Steps

  1. On a test build, set NEXT_PUBLIC_REFUNDS=true and rebuild.
  2. Try a refund from the donations list.
  3. Set the flag back to false.

Expected

  • The action answers "This feature is not available yet." and nothing is shown as refunded.
